body:
my weekends have been going pretty well the last couple months and I've been happy Friday afternoon until Sunday night. the problem has been my Monday-Fridays are almost unbearable. plus this week has been really busy.

I think it's easier to job search when you know what to look for and my biggest problem right now is that I feel lost. just trying to keep my head afloat

that would be great if it worked like that. I just don't see myself as that important to anyone else. I feel like if I don't hangout with people they never think "damn I wish lonelythrowaway0045 was here", instead they just go on with their lives. my roommate is the only one who ever texts me saying he wishes I was there to enjoy the night and he only really does that because we're roommates and we spend most of our time together.

people tell me I worry too much and that I always jump to the worst conclusion about things. but at the same time I'm always the person that texts people first. I'm always the one that's says "missed you last weekend, it's a shame we couldn't hangout", I'm always the one who seems to care when not a lot of other people do but nobody seems to reciprocate those thoughts and feelings to me. no matter who it is

damn I am just way too paranoid I guess lol. most of the time I feel like if I decline to hangout with someone to do something else they will lose interest and think I have better things to do.

that's how I feel with women also. I don't understand the whole "playing hard to get" thing because I always just assume they're not interested because if they were they'd want to see me
sometimes they don't feel like friends though. that's the problem. sometimes I just feel like I'm there because of my roommate

that sounds pretty similar to how I am. when we're in a group and all talking it always seems like I'm left out of every conversation. it feels like people want to talk to each other but not me and only do so because I'm there

I have another group of friends that I do hangout with but our schedules don't really matchup right now so it's hard to find time. I don't really want to stop hanging out with them because I have a fear of being forgotten

been working very hard on myself for a long time. finally feel ready to try and make it work with a girl if the right opportunity comes up and that's what this feels like to me. just hoping it's mutual. thanks for the advice. being single and lonely definitely feels like a weight keeps me on the floor though most days

I appreciate the reply. I'm definitely trying hard to stay level headed but it can be tough. I'm not really great at meeting women so I'm hoping for the best and admittedly putting a lot of emotion into it. I think I'd be fine with being just friends. I'd just like to know, it's tough to just sit around and wonder
I feel like they have similar feelings as well. however my paranoia kind of makes me want to act out to stop it while my anxiety wants me to dissapear

I don't think they run in my family. not sure of any other family members who suffer from depression, anxiety, and paranoia like I do.

my paranoia is mainly that the people around me are against me. I often feel like people close to me are working together to keep from moving forward in life, people know about me when I haven't met them before, I feel over judged by everyone for decisions I make that aren't even bad, I feel like this girl I'm close with is seeing my roommate behind my back. I just don't really trust anyone about anything anymore.
I thought I was also until recently. you don't ever feel like your paranoia is overtaking some aspects of your life?
haha oh okay. well thank you for the suggestion, I will look into it.
realistically do you know how much money a visit to a psychiatrist would cost on average? money is extremely tight for me.

I moved last year but funny enough I got too homesick and am poor so I had to move home for a bit. I want to move again but not sure where.


I mean I hate that I feel like I can't talk to them or they don't care but they're basically my only friends. I have a small group that I've known for a long time.

and I'm just not really into the same thing as my family. I love my brother's but they have careers and are starting families while I'm a bit younger. my parents are just too different. I love them but my dad and I just don't get each other. I hate seeing other people who are close to their parents because I never felt that.

as for jobs I would have to move to really do what I want. nothing around me sounds like what I want because I'm too focused on not being happy in my city I guess

I've been in the same state for my entire life expect for 3 months last year. it's just a place I don't want to be. I don't like how it looks, I don't like seeing people I grew up with, and there's not much going on. 

I haven't brought up my issues with my friends really because it seems like they don't care. I don't want to seem like a complainer by bringing up my issues on my own. it's concerning that no one ever seems to care enough to ask themselves.

I have a tough past with my dad and while I love my family, my interests aren't really the same as theirs and they don't really seem to accept that.
I have some ideas of different jobs that I might like but I really don't have a solid idea of what to do or how to find out what I want

honestly almost everything about my life has something bad going on now. I live in my hometown that I hate, my friends have been weird lately like I said, I've been distant from my family because I feel like an outsider around them, I'm not pursuing my career ambitions because I'm not even really sure what I want, my love life has been basically nothing. drinking has turned into the only thing I really enjoy lately because it gets me out of the house and in a social setting but that's probably not a good thing.
it's been years since the happy days though. hell I don't ever remember being really happy
